output.summary: The 95% green dashboard is unreliable. Status is self-reported with no objective criteria, and the SVP's red/amber memo plus a bonus tied to percent-green created pressure to report green. Internal Audit, a lead's account and the escalation log all show slippage hidden behind green. CSD's Platform problem is largely self-inflicted: 58% of its requests are returned for incomplete specs, and need-by lead times are short. Complete, early requests land 87% on time. Platform has a real but modest capacity shortfall that slows all divisions. Whether the SVP directed the green-shifting is unproven. The best next step is to fix measurement independently and tie incentives to outcomes. Reject the transfer and SLA request, reject the SVP removal, and reject de-anonymizing survey authors.
